test_title: PYST 19: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 18th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence: The supervisor __is irritated at__ the assistant.
solution:
The correct answer is '**is annoyed with**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition **"with"** is used to indicate the object of the annoyance.
 
• The phrase **"is annoyed with"** is the correct collocation and fits the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2** ("angry on") is incorrect because "on" is not used with "angry."
 
• O
